title: 有馬記念の後に・至宝

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wins the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to challenge every peak moving forward and contribute to the development of the Japanese Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition, she promises Kitasan Black that they'll always be by each other's sides.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though they walk different paths, they'll both keep running together as they continue forward.
